what: A dark, easy groovebox for acid lines and chopped breaks. RITUAL blends two of 11 styles into a full 4-track song with one button; MELODY writes tunes that are always in key; DICE re-rolls one part at a time; easy time-stretch, a three-head tape echo and an eye that reacts to the music.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL samples (piano, flute, sax, kept from Felucca); the FM voice bank and sounds/DarkFunkDurcal_DX7.syx are own
